categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: smart water services and rare earth resource recycling. The smart water segment includes the development, production, and sales of various water meters (mechanical and smart types), water management software, and integrated water service solutions. The rare earth segment focuses on recycling and processing rare earth waste materials to produce rare earth oxides, serving as a key part of the rare earth supply chain.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as NB-IoT communication, 5G, ultrasonic and electromagnetic sensing for smart water meters. It employs acid and combined alkali-acid extraction processes for rare earth recycling, achieving high product yields (~96%). The smart water production has transitioned to a lean, automated 5G digital factory with over 95% automation, integrating digital twin, AI, and edge computing technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include municipal water supply companies, water utilities, and industrial clients requiring water metering and management solutions. The rare earth products are sold mainly to metal processing and permanent magnet manufacturers. The company serves domestic markets extensively across China and exports smart water meters to over 60 countries including Europe, Southeast Asia, Africa, Oceania, and South America.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in China, with headquarters and manufacturing in Jiangxi Province. The company has a nationwide sales network covering Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest regions. Export markets span multiple continents, with significant growth in overseas sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: In the smart water segment, the company operates mainly in midstream manufacturing and downstream system integration and service provision. In the rare earth segment, it occupies a midstream position focusing on recycling and refining rare earth waste materials, linking upstream waste suppliers and downstream rare earth metal producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes dual strategic development: upgrading the water segment with integrated smart metering, energy, and quality water supply solutions, and steady expansion of the rare earth recycling business. R&D focuses on advancing smart water meter technologies (NB-IoT, 5G, ultrasonic), water management platforms, and improving rare earth recycling efficiency and cost reduction. It also pursues digital transformation via a 5G smart factory and process automation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of smart water meters, water management software and systems, and rare earth oxide products. The company also earns income from water service operations, software as a service (SaaS) platforms, and leasing of equipment and facilities. Direct sales and distributor channels are used for product distribution.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the earliest and leading smart water meter manufacturers and smart water service providers in China, holding a significant market share with strong brand recognition. In rare earth recycling, its subsidiary is among the few with advanced capabilities in processing complex waste like molten salt slag, holding a leading position in this niche. The industry is competitive with many players, but the company’s integrated technology and full-industry chain service capabilities provide competitive barriers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.47 billion, a 35.5% decline from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 63.8 million, down 73.4%. The decline was mainly due to rare earth price drops and operational difficulties in the rare earth subsidiary. The company’s total assets were about RMB 2.93 billion. Despite short-term setbacks, the company is investing in digital transformation and innovation to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers comprehensive smart water solutions combining hardware (various smart water meters) and software (cloud platforms, data analytics) to improve water management efficiency and accuracy. Its rare earth recycling business provides high-yield, high-quality recycled rare earth oxides using advanced processes, addressing supply constraints and environmental concerns. The 5G smart factory and integrated R&D capabilities differentiate it by enabling high automation, product quality, and innovation speed.
